known_limitations: INCIDENT XCHECK-FAIL (blocking-level disclosure, escalated to A1): the mandatory cross-check of the frozen 15m catalog resampled to 1h vs the Vision 1h series FAILED at the pre-declared tolerance (price 0.01 abs / volume 1e-9 rel). Forensics: alignment correct (shift-scan optimum +0h, close corr 0.999969), both decodes sane (VWAP within bar range), yet per-hour volume differs ~12x at the median (per-day vision/catalog ratios 0.01..32) and close diffs reach +/-6800 points => the frozen catalog is not a complete/consistent trade record over the overlap; instrument-identity assurance for the V2-era window could NOT be established. Law applied: no smoothing, no tolerance relaxation. The plan-prescribed scored source (Vision, integrity PASS) proceeds; A1 must adjudicate (accept, re-baseline, or strike the lane).

TRANSITION_UNKNOWN is NOT_RUN_THIN_PHASE (3 episodes vs floor 20; margin -17; 171 decisions; F3 has zero UNKNOWN bars): with the frozen margin band the sustained-uncertainty state is genuinely rare on this cell; slot FLAT. Valid result, not a failure.

ACC and DOWN candidates have thin first-fold entry counts (5 and 4 entries in F1 of the dry-run); phase floors pass on episode/decision counts, but scored-run fold robustness (G4) is at risk - disclosed, not hidden.
Per-episode gross-edge assumptions (200/500/200 bps) are stated mechanism-grounded assumptions frozen before scoring; they are NOT measured returns and the scored run adjudicates them.

Plan text ambiguity: sec7.2 says proposals 'within |rho| <= 0.20' are VETOED while sec13 E3 lists 'rho <= 0.20' as an eligibility PASS; the lane applies the E3 reading (|rho| <= 0.20 => distinct; |rho| > 0.20 => same-mechanism veto), records all rho values, and defers to A1 adjudication.

Stop-window law clarification (frozen pre-scoring, before any scored PnL): Donchian stop/exit extremes use PRIOR-bar windows (excluding the current bar) so a bar making a new extreme can trigger on itself; census/dry-run artifacts were regenerated after this clarification and tests pin it.
DISTRIBUTION carries NO_ELIGIBLE_PROPOSAL under the strict default (no evidenced forced-counterparty mechanism expressible from OHLCV-only data); this is a design decision, not a data failure.
Raw zips and the staged parquet live in gitignored data_staging/ (retrievable from the pinned manifest URLs); only digests are in git.
